newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman starts Vail as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman starts Vail as buy.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs & Co said it started coverage of Vail Resorts Inc with a buy rating and put the ski mountain resort company on its recommended list.
-- Goldman was one of the underwriters of the company's February initial public offering.
-- That shares rose 3/4 to 18-1/4 early Monday afternoon. Vail went public at $22 a share.
-- Goldman is the last of the IPO's underwriters to initiate coverage of the stock.
-- Bear Stearns, Smith Barney, and Salomon Brothers have rated the shares a buy. Schroder Wertheim has given an outperform rating to Vail.
-- Furman Selz has said it recommends purchase of the stock with a 12-month price target of $30.
